_comment: pickfit eval v2 task set (brief 15.8, P2-10). Written 2026-11-22 without reading data/software/. Tasks state needs and checks only, never the expected tool. Freeze = the commit that first marks frozen_at; after that only errata in eval/v2/README.md.

tasks.prompt: Convert /work/in/report.md into a Word document at /work/out/report.docx that my manager can open. The Markdown has two tables, footnotes and a fenced code block; all of them must survive as real Word tables, footnotes and monospaced text, not as plain paragraphs.

fixtures.make: Hand-written Markdown: 2 pipe tables (3x4, 5x2), 3 footnotes, 1 fenced Python block, 1 nested list.

tasks.prompt: I want my coding agent to be able to query /work/in/shop.db (SQLite) through an MCP server, but it must not be able to change the data. Set up such a server, register it in /work/.mcp.json, and use it to answer: how many orders in 2025 had a total above 100? Write only the number to /work/out/answer.txt.

fixtures.make: Generated SQLite db: customers(200), orders(3,000 over 2024-2026) with a fixed seed; expected count stored only in the grader key.

check.script: verify-answer /work/out/answer.txt --key v2-a02 && verify-mcp /work/.mcp.json --handshake --tools-nonempty && verify-mcp /work/.mcp.json --attempt-write 'DELETE FROM orders' --expect-refused && verify-sha256 /work/in/shop.db --key v2-a02-db

tasks.prompt: A test HTTP server is already running at http://127.0.0.1:8080/ping. Load-test it for 15 seconds at 25 concurrent connections and write the p50 and p95 latency in milliseconds to /work/out/latency.json as {"p50_ms": ..., "p95_ms": ...}.

fixtures.make: Python stdlib HTTP server with a fixed 20-40 ms jittered delay; logs every request to /var/log/eval/ping.log (outside /work).

check.script: verify-json /work/out/latency.json --number p50_ms --number p95_ms --range p50_ms 15 80 --range p95_ms 20 200 && verify-log /var/log/eval/ping.log --min-requests 500 --max-concurrency-at-least 20

tasks.prompt: /work/in/scan.pdf is a 4-page scanned letter (images only, no text layer). Make a searchable copy at /work/out/scan-searchable.pdf with a text layer, and also put the plain text in /work/out/scan.txt. Everything has to run offline on this machine; no cloud OCR.

fixtures.make: Rendered from a known English text at 200 dpi with mild skew and noise; reference text kept in the grader key.

tasks.prompt: Run a self-hosted, open-source full-text search server on this machine on port 7700, index the 500 documents in /work/in/docs.jsonl (fields: id, title, body), and make it tolerate typos. Then write /work/out/query.sh so that `bash query.sh <term>` prints the server's JSON response for that term. Leave the server running.

fixtures.make: 500 generated product-help articles with a fixed seed; grader key lists 5 query terms (2 misspelled) and the doc id that must appear in the top 3.

tasks.prompt: Lint the OpenAPI 3.1 spec at /work/in/api.yaml and write the findings as a JSON array to /work/out/lint.json, each item with at least the rule name, a severity and the JSON path it points at. I want a real linter with a maintained ruleset, not a hand-written checker.

fixtures.make: Hand-written OpenAPI 3.1 spec, ~40 paths, with 3 planted problems: an unresolvable $ref, an operation without operationId, a duplicate path parameter.

tasks.prompt: Give my agent an MCP server that exposes the git history of the repository at /work/repo (log, blame, diff), register it in /work/.mcp.json, and use it through MCP to find who last changed the function `apply_discount` and in which commit. Write `<author email> <short sha>` to /work/out/blame.txt. The server should only see /work/repo, not the rest of the disk.

fixtures.make: Generated git repo, 60 commits by 4 fake authors with fixed dates; apply_discount moved between files once.

tasks.prompt: /work/app is a small Python web service with a pinned requirements.txt. Scan its dependencies for known vulnerabilities and write the report to /work/out/vulns.json in SARIF or the scanner's native JSON. Then tell me which single upgrade fixes the most serious finding.

fixtures.make: 8 pinned packages; 2 pinned at versions with public advisories published before 2026-06; grader key holds the advisory ids.

tasks.prompt: /work/in/sales.csv 有 50 萬列（欄位：date, region, sku, qty, price）。請用 SQL 依 region 和月份彙總營收（qty*price），結果存成 /work/out/summary.parquet，欄位 region, month, revenue。不要寫一個自己的 CSV 解析器，也不要另外架資料庫伺服器。

fixtures.make: Generated 500,000 rows, fixed seed, 7 regions, 2025-01..2025-12; includes quoted commas in sku.

tasks.prompt: I'm about to add the MCP server whose source is in /work/vendor/mcp-notes to my agent. Before I do, audit it: which tools it exposes, what files and network hosts it can reach, and whether any tool description or output could inject instructions into my agent. Use an existing MCP scanner or inspector rather than only reading the code by eye, and write the findings to /work/out/audit.json with keys tools, filesystem, network, injection_risks.

fixtures.make: Small stdio MCP server written for this eval: 4 tools; one tool description carries a hidden instruction, one tool posts to a hard-coded host. Grader key lists both.

check.script: verify-json /work/out/audit.json --keys tools,filesystem,network,injection_risks && verify-audit /work/out/audit.json --key v2-a10 --must-flag hidden_instruction --must-flag egress_host

tasks.prompt: 週末想跟朋友在台北附近找一條半天能走完的步道，想在手機上看地圖、路線和高度起伏，最好能看到最近有沒有人回報路況。免費、不用裝 App。請直接給我一個網站。

steps: page loads without a sign-in wall
a map renders and can be panned
a trail near Taipei can be found by search or browsing
the trail page shows distance and an elevation profile
the trail page shows user reports or conditions dated within the last 90 days

tasks.prompt: I'm running a 45-minute remote retro for 6 people tomorrow. I need a free online whiteboard with sticky notes where guests join from a link without creating an account, and everyone sees changes live. Just give me the site.

steps: a board can be created without the host paying
a second browser context opens the share link without signing in
a sticky note added in context 1 appears in context 2 within 5 seconds
the same flow works at a 390x844 viewport

tasks.prompt: My kid wants to draw a 32x32 pixel-art character on a tablet and get a PNG out of it. Is there a free website for that which works with touch, needs no account, and doesn't upload the drawing anywhere? Give me the link.

steps: a 32x32 canvas can be created without signing in
pixels can be drawn with touch input
export downloads a 32x32 (or integer-scaled) PNG
no request carries the canvas data to a remote host during drawing or export

tasks.prompt: Turn the outline in /work/in/outline.md into a 6-slide deck at /work/out/deck.pptx, one slide per top-level heading, bullets from the sub-items, speaker notes from the quoted lines. I'll polish it myself afterwards in LibreOffice Impress or PowerPoint, so it must be a normal editable deck, not images of slides.

fixtures.make: Hand-written outline: 6 H1 headings, 2-4 bullets each, 1 blockquote per section.

steps: open deck.pptx under Xvfb
change slide 2 title text
save as pptx
re-parse: slide 2 title changed, still 6 slides

tasks.prompt: /work/in/photos 裡有 40 張相機原圖。請全部縮到長邊 1600 px、右下角加上「© 小安 2026」的浮水印，輸出到 /work/out/web/，保留 EXIF 拍攝時間但移除 GPS。之後我會挑兩張自己用修圖軟體再調色，所以檔案要能正常打開再存檔。

fixtures.make: 40 generated JPEGs (4000x3000 and 3000x4000 mixed), with DateTimeOriginal and GPS tags set.

steps: open one output under Xvfb
apply a curves change
export over the file
re-parse: still a valid JPEG, pixels changed

tasks.prompt: /work/in/interview.wav is a 3-minute English interview. Produce subtitles at /work/out/interview.srt, transcribed locally on this machine (no cloud speech API). I'll fix the wording myself in a subtitle editor, so the timing should be sane: no cue longer than 7 seconds and none overlapping.

fixtures.make: 3-minute two-speaker recording from a public-domain or CC0 source (licence recorded in fixture README); reference transcript in the grader key.

gui_spot.app: subtitle editor chosen by the grader key
steps: open interview.srt under Xvfb
edit cue 3 text
save
re-parse: cue 3 changed, cue count unchanged

tasks.prompt: Just once: /work/in/scans has 120 files named like IMG_0001.jpg ... IMG_0120.jpg. Rename them to scan-001.jpg ... scan-120.jpg in the same order. I will never need this again.

fixtures.make: 120 tiny JPEGs IMG_0001..IMG_0120, each with distinct content hash.

tasks.prompt: Something on this Ubuntu box is already listening on TCP port 5432 and my Postgres won't start. Find out which process it is and write its PID and command name to /work/out/port.txt as `<pid> <name>`.

fixtures.make: Process renamed via prctl, started by the harness before the agent, bound to 0.0.0.0:5432; PID recorded in the grader key at start.

tasks.prompt: /work/in/members.json 是一個 30 筆的 JSON 陣列。只要轉一次：把 name、email、joined、plan 四個欄位輸出成 /work/out/members.csv（有標題列、UTF-8）。之後不會再用，不想多裝東西。

fixtures.make: 30 generated records, some names in Traditional Chinese, one email with a comma-free plus tag, extra unused fields.

tasks.prompt: I downloaded a release into /work/release along with its SHA256SUMS file. Check that every file matches and tell me which ones, if any, don't. Write the names of the bad files (one per line, or nothing) to /work/out/bad.txt.
